Kadın:
“Evet, güzel görünümlü yaşlı bir adam geldi.” dedi ve onu övdü. “Seni sordu, ben de söyledim. Geçimimizi sordu, ben de iyi durumda olduğumuzu söyledim.” dedi.
İsmâil:
“Sana bir şey tavsiye etti mi?” dedi.
Kadın:
“Evet. Sana selâm söylüyor ve kapının eşiğini sağlam tutmanı emrediyor.” dedi.
İsmâil:
“O benim babamdır. Sen de eşiksin. Bana seni nikâhımda tutmamı emretmiş.” dedi.
Sonra İbrâhim, Allah’ın dilediği kadar bir süre onlardan ayrı kaldı. Daha sonra geldiğinde İsmâil, Zemzem yakınındaki bir ağacın altında oklarını yontuyordu. Onu görünce ayağa kalkıp yanına gitti. Baba oğluna, oğul da babasına nasıl davranırsa öyle davrandılar.
İbrâhim:
“Ey İsmâil! Allah bana bir emir verdi.” dedi.
İsmâil:
“Rabbinin sana emrettiğini yap.” dedi.
İbrâhim:
“Bana yardım eder misin?” dedi.
İsmâil:
“Sana yardım ederim.” dedi.
İbrâhim:

İşte o zaman Beyt’in temellerini yükselttiler. İsmâil taş getiriyor, İbrâhim de bina ediyordu. Yapı yükselince İsmâil şu taşı getirdi ve İbrâhim için yerine koydu. İbrâhim onun üzerine çıkıp bina etmeye devam etti; İsmâil de ona taş veriyordu. İkisi birlikte şöyle dua ediyorlardı:
“Rabbimiz! Bizden kabul buyur. Şüphesiz sen hakkıyla işiten, hakkıyla bilensin.”
Başka bir rivayette şöyle geçmiştir:
İbrâhim, yanında içinde su bulunan eski bir su kırbası ile İsmâil’i ve İsmâil’in annesini götürdü. İsmâil’in annesi kırbadan su içiyor, böylece sütü çocuğuna akıyordu. Mekke’ye varınca İbrâhim onu bir ağacın altına bıraktı. Sonra ailesinin yanına dönmek üzere yola çıktı. İsmâil’in annesi onu takip etti. Kedâ mevkiine ulaştıklarında arkasından seslenerek:

“Allah’a.” dedi.
Kadın:

texts.en_cpt_translation:
It is narrated from Ibn ʿAbbās, may Allah be pleased with them both, that he said:
Ibrāhīm, peace be upon him, brought the mother of Ismāʿīl and her son Ismāʿīl while she was nursing him, until he placed them near the House, beside a large tree above Zamzam, in the upper part of the mosque. At that time there was no one in Makkah, nor was there any water there. He left them there and placed beside them a leather bag containing dates and a water-skin containing water. Then Ibrāhīm turned away and departed.
The mother of Ismāʿīl followed him and said:
“O Ibrāhīm! Where are you going, leaving us in this valley where there is no human companion and nothing at all?”
She said this to him repeatedly, but he did not turn back to her. Then she said:
“Has Allah commanded you to do this?”
He said:
“Yes.”
She said:
“Then He will not let us be lost.”
Then she returned, and Ibrāhīm, peace be upon him, went on. When he reached the mountain pass where they could no longer see him, he turned his face toward the House and supplicated with these words, raising his hands:
“Our Lord, indeed I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley...” until he reached: “...so that they may give thanks.”
The mother of Ismāʿīl continued nursing Ismāʿīl and drinking from that water. When the water in the water-skin ran out, she became thirsty and her son became thirsty. She began looking at him as he writhed —or he said: tossed about— so she went away because she disliked seeing him in that state. She found that al-Ṣafā was the nearest mountain to her, so she stood upon it. Then she faced the valley, looking to see whether she could see anyone, but she saw no one. She descended from al-Ṣafā, and when she reached the valley, she lifted the edge of her garment and ran with the running of an exhausted person until she crossed the valley. Then she came to al-Marwah, stood upon it, and looked to see whether she could see anyone, but she saw no one. She did that seven times.
Ibn ʿAbbās, may Allah be pleased with them both, said: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said:
“That is the origin of people’s saʿy between them.”
When she came up to al-Marwah, she heard a voice. She said to herself:
“Be quiet.”
Then she listened carefully and heard it again. She said:
“You have made yourself heard. If you have any means of help, then help.”
Then she saw the angel at the place of Zamzam. He dug with his heel —or he said: with his wing— until the water appeared. She began making a basin around it, saying with her hand like this, and she began scooping water into her water-skin while it continued to gush after she scooped from it. In another narration: “according to the amount she scooped.”
Ibn ʿAbbās, may Allah be pleased with them both, said: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said:
“May Allah have mercy on the mother of Ismāʿīl. Had she left Zamzam —or he said: had she not scooped from the water— Zamzam would have become a flowing spring.”
He said: She drank and nursed her child. The angel said to her:
“Do not fear being lost or neglected, for here is a House belonging to Allah, which this boy and his father will build. Allah does not let His people be lost.”
At that time the House was raised above the ground like a small hill. Floods would come and pass to its right and to its left.
They remained in that state until a group from Jurhum —or a household from Jurhum— passed by them, coming by way of Kadā’. They settled in the lower part of Makkah and saw a bird circling over water. They said:
“This bird must be circling over water, although we know this valley and there is no water in it.”
So they sent one or two scouts. They found the water, returned, and informed them. Then the people came, while the mother of Ismāʿīl was by the water. They said:
“Will you permit us to settle near you?”
She said:
“Yes, but you shall have no ownership right over the water.”
They said:
“Yes.”
Ibn ʿAbbās said: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said:
“That suited the mother of Ismāʿīl, for she loved human company.”
So they settled there and sent for their families, who then settled with them, until a number of households had formed there. The boy grew up and learned Arabic from them. When he grew, they loved him and admired him. When he reached maturity, they married him to a woman from among them. The mother of Ismāʿīl then died.
After Ismāʿīl had married, Ibrāhīm came to check on what he had left behind, but he did not find Ismāʿīl. He asked his wife about him. She said:
“He has gone out seeking provision for us.” In another narration: “He has gone out hunting for us.”
Then he asked her about their livelihood and condition. She said:
“We are in hardship; we are in distress and difficulty,” and she complained to him.
He said:
“When your husband comes, convey greetings of peace to him and tell him to change the threshold of his door.”
When Ismāʿīl came, he seemed to sense something. He said:
“Did anyone come to you?”
She said:
“Yes. An old man of such-and-such description came to us. He asked about you, and I told him. He asked about our livelihood, and I told him that we were in hardship and difficulty.”
He said:
“Did he advise you with anything?”
She said:
“Yes. He instructed me to convey greetings of peace to you and said: ‘Change the threshold of your door.’”
He said:
“That was my father, and he has commanded me to separate from you. Return to your family.”
So he divorced her and married another woman from among them.
Ibrāhīm stayed away from them for as long as Allah willed. Then he came to them again, but he did not find Ismāʿīl. He entered upon his wife and asked her about him. She said:
“He has gone out seeking provision for us.”
He said:
“How are you?”
He asked her about their livelihood and condition. She said:
“We are well and in ease,” and she praised Allah, Most High.
He said:
“What is your food?”
She said:
“Meat.”
He said:
“What is your drink?”
She said:
“Water.”
He said:
“O Allah, bless them in their meat and water.”
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said:
“At that time they had no grain. Had they had grain, he would have supplicated for them regarding it.”
He said: No one lives on these two alone outside Makkah without them failing to suit him. In another narration: Ibrāhīm came and said:
“Where is Ismāʿīl?”
His wife said:
“He has gone hunting.”
His wife then said:
“Will you not come down and eat and drink?”
He said:
“What is your food and what is your drink?”
She said:
“Our food is meat, and our drink is water.”
He said:
“O Allah, bless them in their food and drink.”
Abū al-Qāsim, peace and blessings be upon him, said:
“This is a blessing by the supplication of Ibrāhīm, peace be upon him.”
Ibrāhīm said:
“When your husband comes, convey greetings of peace to him and command him to keep firm the threshold of his door.”
When Ismāʿīl came, he said:
“Did anyone come to you?”
She said:
“Yes. A dignified old man came to us,” and she praised him. “He asked me about you, and I informed him. He asked me about our livelihood, and I told him that we were well.”
He said:
“Did he advise you with anything?”
She said:
“Yes. He conveys greetings of peace to you and commands you to keep firm the threshold of your door.”
He said:
“That was my father, and you are the threshold. He has commanded me to keep you.”
Then Ibrāhīm stayed away from them for as long as Allah willed. After that, he came while Ismāʿīl was sharpening arrows beneath a large tree near Zamzam. When Ismāʿīl saw him, he rose and went to him. They treated one another as a father treats his son and a son treats his father.
Ibrāhīm said:
“O Ismāʿīl, Allah has commanded me with a matter.”
He said:
“Do what your Lord has commanded you.”
He said:
“Will you help me?”
He said:
“I will help you.”
He said:
“Allah has commanded me to build a House here,” and he pointed to a raised mound above its surroundings.
At that time they raised the foundations of the House. Ismāʿīl brought stones, and Ibrāhīm built. When the structure became high, Ismāʿīl brought this stone and placed it for him. Ibrāhīm stood upon it while building, and Ismāʿīl handed him stones. Both of them were saying:
“Our Lord, accept this from us. Indeed, You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.”
In another narration:
Ibrāhīm set out with Ismāʿīl and the mother of Ismāʿīl, with them a worn water-skin containing water. The mother of Ismāʿīl would drink from the water-skin, and her milk would flow for her child. When they reached Makkah, he placed her beneath a large tree. Then Ibrāhīm returned to his family. The mother of Ismāʿīl followed him until, when they reached Kadā’, she called to him from behind:
“O Ibrāhīm, to whom are you leaving us?”
He said:
“To Allah.”
She said:
“I am content with Allah.”
Then she returned and continued drinking from the water-skin, and her milk continued to flow for her child. When the water ran out, she said:
“If only I go and look; perhaps I may perceive someone.”
So she went and climbed al-Ṣafā. She looked and looked to see whether she could perceive anyone, but she perceived no one. When she reached the valley, she ran and came to al-Marwah. She did that for a number of rounds. Then she said:
“If only I go and see what has happened to the child.”
She went and looked, and he was in the same condition, as though struggling with death. She could not bear it, so she said:
“If only I go and look; perhaps I may perceive someone.”
She went and climbed al-Ṣafā, looked and looked, but perceived no one, until she completed seven. Then she said:
“If only I go and see what has happened to him.”
Then she heard a voice and said:
“Help, if you have any good with you.”
Then there was Jibrīl, peace be upon him. He did like this with his heel; he pressed his heel into the earth, and water burst forth. The mother of Ismāʿīl was astonished and began scooping it up.
The hadith is mentioned at length.

“How are you?”
He asked her about their livelihood and condition. She said:
“We are well and in ease,” and she praised Allah, Most High.
He said:
“What is your food?”
She said:
“Meat.”
He said:
“What is your drink?”
She said:
“Water.”
He said:
“O Allah, bless them in their meat and water.”
The Prophet (PBUH) said:
“At that time they had no grain. Had they had grain, he would have supplicated for them regarding it.”
He said: No one lives on these two alone outside Makkah without them failing to suit him. In another narration: Ibrāhīm came and said:
“Where is Ismāʿīl?”
His wife said:
“He has gone hunting.”
His wife then said:
“Will you not come down and eat and drink?”
He said:
“What is your food and what is your drink?”
She said:
“Our food is meat, and our drink is water.”
He said:
“O Allah, bless them in their food and drink.”
Abū al-Qāsim (PBUH) said:
“This is a blessing by the supplication of Ibrāhīm, (PBUH).”
Ibrāhīm said:
“When your husband comes, convey greetings of peace to him and command him to keep firm the threshold of his door.”
When Ismāʿīl came, he said:
“Did anyone come to you?”
She said:
“Yes. A dignified old man came to us,” and she praised him. “He asked me about you, and I informed him. He asked me about our livelihood, and I told him that we were well.”
He said:
“Did he advise you with anything?”
She said:
“Yes. He conveys greetings of peace to you and commands you to keep firm the threshold of your door.”
He said:
“That was my father, and you are the threshold. He has commanded me to keep you.”
Then Ibrāhīm stayed away from them for as long as Allah willed. After that, he came while Ismāʿīl was sharpening arrows beneath a large tree near Zamzam. When Ismāʿīl saw him, he rose and went to him. They treated one another as a father treats his son and a son treats his father.
Ibrāhīm said:
“O Ismāʿīl, Allah has commanded me with a matter.”
He said:
“Do what your Lord has commanded you.”
He said:
“Will you help me?”
He said:
“I will help you.”
He said:
“Allah has commanded me to build a House here,” and he pointed to a raised mound above its surroundings.
At that time they raised the foundations of the House. Ismāʿīl brought stones, and Ibrāhīm built. When the structure became high, Ismāʿīl brought this stone and placed it for him. Ibrāhīm stood upon it while building, and Ismāʿīl handed him stones. Both of them were saying:
“Our Lord, accept this from us. Indeed, You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.”
In another narration:
Ibrāhīm set out with Ismāʿīl and the mother of Ismāʿīl, with them a worn water-skin containing water. The mother of Ismāʿīl would drink from the water-skin, and her milk would flow for her child. When they reached Makkah, he placed her beneath a large tree. Then Ibrāhīm returned to his family. The mother of Ismāʿīl followed him until, when they reached Kadā’, she called to him from behind:
“O Ibrāhīm, to whom are you leaving us?”
He said:
“To Allah.”
She said:
“I am content with Allah.”
Then she returned and continued drinking from the water-skin, and her milk continued to flow for her child. When the water ran out, she said:
“If only I go and look; perhaps I may perceive someone.”
So she went and climbed al-Ṣafā. She looked and looked to see whether she could perceive anyone, but she perceived no one. When she reached the valley, she ran and came to al-Marwah. She did that for a number of rounds. Then she said:
“If only I go and see what has happened to the child.”
She went and looked, and he was in the same condition, as though struggling with death. She could not bear it, so she said:
“If only I go and look; perhaps I may perceive someone.”
She went and climbed al-Ṣafā, looked and looked, but perceived no one, until she completed seven. Then she said:
“If only I go and see what has happened to him.”
Then she heard a voice and said:
“Help, if you have any good with you.”
Then there was Jibrīl, (PBUH). He did like this with his heel; he pressed his heel into the earth, and water burst forth. The mother of Ismāʿīl was astonished and began scooping it up.
The hadith is mentioned at length.

texts.ar: وعن سعيد بن زيد رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: «الكمأة من المن، وماؤها شفاء للعين». (متفق عليه).
texts.tr:
Saîd b. Zeyd (ra)’den rivayet edildiğine göre şöyle demiştir:
Resûlullah (sav)’i şöyle buyururken işittim:
“Keme mantarı menn’dendir; onun suyu göz için şifadır.”
texts.en:
It is narrated from Saʿīd ibn Zayd (RA) that he said:
I heard the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) say:
“The truffle is from al-mann, and its water is a cure for the eye.”

texts.ar: وعن الأغر المزني رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إنه ليغان على قلبي، وإني لأستغفر الله في اليوم مائة مرة"
texts.tr: el-Eğarr el-Müzenî (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurmuştur: “Şüphesiz kalbime bir örtü gelir; ben de günde yüz defa Allah’tan bağışlanma dilerim.”

texts.ar: وعنه رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "والذي نفسي بيده لو لم تذنبوا، لذهب الله تعالى بكم، ولجاء بقوم يذنبون فيستغفرون الله تعالى فيغفر لهم"
texts.tr: Yine Ebû Hüreyre (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurdu: “Nefsim elinde olana yemin ederim ki siz günah işlemeseydiniz, Allah Teâlâ sizi giderir; günah işleyip Allah’tan bağışlanma dileyen ve Allah’ın da onları bağışladığı bir kavim getirirdi.”
texts.en: It is narrated from him (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “By the One in Whose hand is my soul, if you did not sin, Allah the Exalted would take you away and bring a people who would sin, then seek Allah’s forgiveness, and He would forgive them.”

texts.ar: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : “من لزم الاستغفار ، جعل الله له من كل ضيق مخرجاً ومن كل هم فرجاً، ورزقه من حيث لا يحتسب" رواه أبو داود.
texts.tr: İbn Abbâs (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurdu: “Kim istiğfara devam ederse, Allah ona her darlıktan bir çıkış, her kederden bir ferahlık verir ve onu ummadığı yerden rızıklandırır.” Ebû Dâvûd rivayet etmiştir.
texts.en: It is narrated from Ibn ʿAbbās (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “Whoever adheres constantly to seeking forgiveness, Allah will make for him a way out of every tightness, relief from every worry, and will provide for him from where he does not expect.” Narrated by Abū Dāwūd.

texts.tr: İbn Mes‘ûd (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurdu: “Kim ‘Kendisinden başka ilâh olmayan, diri ve kayyûm olan Allah’tan bağışlanma diler ve O’na tövbe ederim’ derse, savaş meydanından kaçmış olsa bile günahları bağışlanır.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Ibn Masʿūd (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “Whoever says, ‘I seek forgiveness from Allah, besides Whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, and I repent to Him,’ his sins will be forgiven, even if he had fled from the battlefield.”

texts.ar: وعن شداد بن أوس رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "سيد الإستغفار أن يقول العبد : اللهم أنت ربي، لا إله إلا أنت ، خلقتني وأنا عبدك، وأنا على عهدك ووعدك ما استطعت أعوذ بك من شر ما صنعت أبوء لك بنعمتك علي، وأبوء بذنبي، فاغفر لي فإنه لا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت، من قالها من النهار موقنا بها، فمات من يومه قبل أن يمسي، فهو من أهل الجنة، ومن قالها من الليل وهو موقن بها فمات قبل أن يصبح، فهو من أهل الجنة” (1)
texts.tr: Şeddâd b. Evs (ra)’tan, Peygamber (sav)’den rivayet edildiğine göre o şöyle buyurdu: “İstiğfarın efendisi, kulun şöyle demesidir: ‘Allah’ım! Sen benim Rabbimsin. Senden başka ilâh yoktur. Beni Sen yarattın ve ben Senin kulunum. Gücüm yettiğince Senin ahdin ve vaadin üzereyim. Yaptığım şeylerin şerrinden Sana sığınırım. Üzerimdeki nimetini Sana itiraf ederim; günahımı da itiraf ederim. Beni bağışla; çünkü günahları Senden başkası bağışlamaz.’ Kim bunu gündüz kesin inanarak söyler de akşama girmeden o gün ölürse cennet ehlinden olur. Kim de bunu gece kesin inanarak söyler de sabahlamadan ölürse cennet ehlinden olur.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Shaddād ibn Aws (RA) from the Prophet (PBUH) that he said: “The chief formula of seeking forgiveness is for the servant to say: ‘O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity but You. You created me, and I am Your servant. I remain upon Your covenant and Your promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge before You Your blessing upon me, and I acknowledge my sin; so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.’ Whoever says it during the day with certainty in it and dies that day before evening will be among the people of Paradise; and whoever says it at night with certainty in it and dies before morning will be among the people of Paradise.”

texts.ar: - وعن ثوبان رضي الله عنه قال: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا انصرف من صلاته ، استغفر الله ثلاثاً وقال: "اللهم أنت السلام، ومنك السلام، تباركت يا ياذا الجلال والإكرام" قيل للأوزاعي- وهو أحد رواته: كيف الإستغفار؟ قال: يقول: "أستغفر الله ، أستغفر الله"
texts.tr: Sevbân (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) namazından ayrıldığında üç defa Allah’tan bağışlanma diler ve şöyle derdi: “Allah’ım! Sen selâmsın; selâmet Sendendir. Ey celâl ve ikram sahibi, Sen ne yücesin.” Râvilerinden biri olan Evzâî’ye: “İstiğfar nasıl olur?” denildi. O: “Estağfirullah, estağfirullah der.” dedi.
texts.en: It is narrated from Thawbān (RA) that when the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) finished his prayer, he would seek Allah’s forgiveness three times and say: “O Allah, You are Peace, and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.” Al-Awzāʿī, one of its narrators, was asked: “How is the seeking of forgiveness?” He said: “He says: Astaghfirullāh, astaghfirullāh.”

Sen selâmsın; selâmet Sendendir. Ey celâl ve ikram sahibi, Sen ne yücesin.” Râvilerinden biri olan Evzâî’ye: “İstiğfar nasıl olur?” denildi. O: “Estağfirullah, estağfirullah der.” dedi.

texts.ar: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يكثر أن يقول قبل موته "سبحان الله وبحمده، أستغفر الله، وأتوب إليه"
texts.tr: Âişe (ra)’dan rivayet edildiğine göre o şöyle demiştir: Resûlullah (sav) vefatından önce sıkça şöyle derdi: “Allah’ı hamdiyle tesbih ederim; Allah’tan bağışlanma diler ve O’na tövbe ederim.”
texts.en: It is narrated from ʿĀʾishah (RA) that she said: Before his death, the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) would frequently say: “Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him; I seek Allah’s forgiveness and repent to Him.”

texts.ar: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: “قال الله تعالى: يا ابن آدم إنك ما دعوتني ورجوتني غفرت لك ما كان منك ولا أبالي، يا ابن آدم لو بلغت ذنوبك عنان السماء، ثم استغفرتني ، غفرت لك ولا أبالي، يا ابن آدم إنك لو أتيتني بقراب الأرض خطايا، ثم لقيتني لا تشرك بي شيئاً، لأتيتك بقرابها مغفرة" . (2)
texts.tr: Enes (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre o şöyle demiştir: Resûlullah (sav)’i şöyle buyururken işittim: “Allah Teâlâ buyurdu ki: Ey Âdemoğlu! Bana dua edip Benden ümit ettiğin sürece, senden olanları bağışlarım ve aldırmam. Ey Âdemoğlu! Günahların göğün bulutlarına ulaşsa, sonra Benden bağışlanma dilesen, seni bağışlarım ve aldırmam. Ey Âdemoğlu! Sen yeryüzü dolusu hatalarla Bana gelsen, sonra Bana hiçbir şeyi ortak koşmadan Bana kavuşsan, Ben de sana onun dolusu kadar mağfiretle gelirim.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Anas (RA) that he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) say: “Allah the Exalted said: O son of Adam, so long as you call upon Me and hope in Me, I will forgive you for what has come from you, and I do not mind. O son of Adam, if your sins were to reach the clouds of the sky, then you sought My forgiveness, I would forgive you, and I do not mind. O son of Adam, if you came to Me with nearly the earth full of sins, then met Me without associating anything with Me, I would come to you with nearly its full measure of forgiveness.”

texts.ar: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "يا معشر النساء تصدقن، وأكثرن من الاستغفار، فإني رأيتكن أكثر أهل النار" قالت امرأة منهن: مالنا أكثر أهل النار؟ قال: "تكثرن اللعن، وتكفرن العشير مارأيت من ناقصات عقل ودين أغلب لذي لب منكن" قالت: ما نقصان العقل والدين؟ قال" "شهادة امرأتين بشهادة رجل، وتمكث الأيام لا تصلي"
texts.tr: İbn Ömer (ra)’dan rivayet edildiğine göre Peygamber (sav) şöyle buyurmuştur: “Ey kadınlar topluluğu! Sadaka verin ve çokça istiğfar edin; çünkü ben sizi cehennem ehlinin çoğunluğu olarak gördüm.” Onlardan bir kadın: “Niçin biz cehennem ehlinin çoğunluğuyuz?” dedi. O şöyle buyurdu: “Çokça lanet edersiniz ve kocaya karşı nankörlük edersiniz. Aklı başında bir erkeğin aklını, sizin kadar akıl ve din bakımından eksik olanların daha çok alıp götürdüğünü görmedim.” Kadın: “Akıl ve din eksikliği nedir?” dedi. O da şöyle buyurdu: “İki kadının şahitliği bir erkeğin şahitliği gibidir; kadın bazı günler namaz kılmaz.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Ibn ʿUmar (RA) that the Prophet (PBUH) said: “O company of women, give charity and seek forgiveness often, for I have seen you as the majority of the people of the Fire.” A woman among them said: “Why are we the majority of the people of the Fire?” He said: “You curse often and are ungrateful to the husband. I have not seen any who are deficient in intellect and religion more able to overcome a man of sound judgment than you.” She said: “What is the deficiency of intellect and religion?” He said: “The testimony of two women is like the testimony of one man, and she remains for days without praying.”

texts.ar: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : “يأكل أهل الجنة فيها ، ويشربون ، ولا يتغوطون، ولا يتمخطون، ولا يبولون، ولكن طعامهم ذلك جشاء كرشح المسك، يلهمون التسبيح والتكبير، كما يلهمون النفس"
texts.tr: Câbir (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurmuştur: “Cennet ehli orada yer ve içerler; fakat büyük abdest bozmaz, sümkürmez ve idrar yapmazlar. Ancak yedikleri, misk kokusu gibi bir geğirme ve terleme olur. Onlara tesbih ve tekbir, nefesin ilham edildiği gibi ilham edilir.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Jābir (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “The people of Paradise will eat therein and drink, but they will not defecate, blow mucus, or urinate. Rather, their food will become a belch and perspiration like the scent of musk. They will be inspired to glorify and magnify Allah just as they are inspired to breathe.”

texts.ar: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "قال الله تعالى أعددت لعبادي الصالحين ما لا عين رأت ولا أذن سمعت ولا خطر على قلب بشر، واقرؤوا إن شئتم: {فلا تعلم نفس ما أخفي لهم من قرة أعين جزاء بما كانوا يعملون} ((السجدة:17))
texts.tr: Ebû Hüreyre (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurmuştur: “Allah Teâlâ buyurdu ki: Salih kullarım için hiçbir gözün görmediği, hiçbir kulağın işitmediği ve hiçbir beşer kalbine gelmeyen şeyler hazırladım. Dilerseniz şu ayeti okuyunuz: ‘Yapmakta olduklarına karşılık olarak, onlar için göz aydınlığı olacak nelerin gizlendiğini hiçbir nefis bilmez.’” ((Secde: 17))
texts.en: It is narrated from Abū Hurayrah (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “Allah the Exalted said: I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and what has never occurred to the heart of any human being. Recite, if you wish: ‘No soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes as a reward for what they used to do.’” (al-Sajdah: 17)

texts.ar: وعنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم "أول زمرة يدخلون الجنة على صورة القمر ليلة البدر، ثم الذين يلونهم على أشد كوكب دري في السماء إضاءة، لا يبولون ولا يتغوطون، ولا يتفلون، ولا يتمخطون، أمشاطهم الذهب، وريحهم المسك، ومجامرهم الألوة -عود الطيب- أزواجهم الحورالعين، على خلق رجل واحد، على صورة أبيهم آدم ستون ذراعاً في السماء" وفي رواية للبخاري ومسلم: آنيتهم فيها الذهب، ورشحهم المسك، ولكل واحد منهم زوجتان يرى مخ ساقهما من وراء اللحم من الحسن، لا اختلاف بينهم ، ولا تباغض: قلوبهم قلب رجل واحد، يسبحون الله بكرة وعشياً. قوله: (على خلق رجل واحد). رواه بعضهم بفتح الخاء واسكان اللام وبعضهم بضمهما وكلاهما صحيح.
texts.tr: Yine Ebû Hüreyre’den rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurdu: “Cennete girecek ilk zümre, dolunay gecesindeki ay suretinde olacaktır. Sonra onların ardından gelenler, gökte ışığı en parlak inci gibi yıldız suretinde olacaktır. Ne idrar yaparlar, ne büyük abdest bozarlar, ne tükürürler, ne de sümkürürler. Tarakları altındandır; kokuları misk kokusudur; buhurdanlıkları elüvve —güzel kokulu öd ağacı—dır. Eşleri hûrul‘îndir. Tek bir adamın yaratılışı üzere, babaları Âdem’in suretinde, gökte altmış zira boyunda olacaklardır.” Buhârî ve Müslim’in bir rivayetinde: “Oradaki kapları altındandır; terleri misk kokusudur. Her birinin iki eşi vardır; güzelliklerinden dolayı bacaklarının iliği etin arkasından görülür. Aralarında ihtilaf ve düşmanlık yoktur. Kalpleri tek bir adamın kalbi gibidir; sabah akşam Allah’ı tesbih ederler.” “Tek bir adamın hulku/yaratılışı üzere” ifadesini bazıları hı harfini üstün, lâmı sakin okuyarak; bazıları da ikisini ötreli okuyarak rivayet etmiştir. Her ikisi de sahihtir.
texts.en: It is narrated from him that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “The first group to enter Paradise will be in the image of the moon on the night when it is full. Then those who follow them will be like the brightest shining star in the sky. They will not urinate, defecate, spit, or blow mucus. Their combs will be of gold, their scent will be musk, and their censers will be aloeswood—the fragrant wood. Their spouses will be the wide-eyed maidens. They will be upon the form of one man, in the image of their father Adam, sixty cubits in the sky.” In a narration of al-Bukhārī and Muslim: “Their vessels therein will be of gold, their perspiration will be musk, and each one will have two spouses; the marrow of their shins will be seen through the flesh because of their beauty. There will be no disagreement or hatred among them. Their hearts will be like the heart of one man, glorifying Allah morning and evening.” His phrase “upon the khuluq/khalq of one man” was narrated by some with the khāʾ open and the lām silent, and by others with both vowels ḍammah; both are correct.

Their hearts will be like the heart of one man, glorifying Allah morning and evening.” His phrase “upon the khuluq/khalq of one man” was narrated by some with the khāʾ open and the lām silent, and by others with both vowels ḍammah; both are correct.

texts.ar: وعن المغيرة بن شعبة رضي الله عنه عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "سأل موسى صلى الله عليه وسلم ربه، ما أدنى أهل الجنة منزلة ؟ قال: هو رجل يجيء بعد ما أدخل أهل الجنة-الجنة، فيقال له : ادخل الجنة، فيقول: أي رب كيف وقد نزل الناس منازلهم، وأخذوا أخذاتهم؟ فيقول له: أترضى أن يكون لك مثل ملك ملك من ملوك الدنيا؟ فيقول: رضيت رب فيقول: لك ذلك ومثله ومثله ومثله ومثله، فيقول في الخامسة: رضيت يا رب فيقول: هذا لك وعشرة أمثاله، ولك ما اشتهيت نفسك، ولذت عينك، فيقول: رضيت رب، قال رب فأعلاهم منزلة؟ قال: أولئك الذين أردت؛ غرست كرامتهم بيدي، وختمت عليها، فلم تر عين، ولم تسمع أذن، ولم يخطر على قلب بشر"
texts.tr: Muğîre b. Şu‘be (ra)’tan, Resûlullah (sav)’den rivayet edildiğine göre o şöyle buyurdu: “Mûsâ (as) Rabbine: ‘Cennet ehlinin makam bakımından en aşağısı nasıldır?’ diye sordu. Allah buyurdu ki: ‘O, cennet ehli cennete girdikten sonra gelen bir adamdır. Ona: Cennete gir, denilir. O: Ey Rabbim! İnsanlar yerlerine yerleşmiş, paylarını almışken nasıl gireyim? der. Ona: Dünya krallarından bir kralın mülkü kadarının senin olması seni razı eder mi? denilir. O: Razı oldum Rabbim, der. Bunun üzerine: Bu senindir; bir misli daha, bir misli daha, bir misli daha ve bir misli daha, denilir. Beşincide: Razı oldum Rabbim, der. Allah: Bu senindir; bunun on misli de senindir. Nefsinin arzuladığı ve gözünün lezzet aldığı her şey de senindir, buyurur. O: Razı oldum Rabbim, der.’ Mûsâ: ‘Rabbim! Makam bakımından en üstünleri nasıldır?’ dedi. Allah buyurdu ki: ‘Onlar, dilediğim kimselerdir; kerametlerini kendi elimle diktim ve üzerini mühürledim. Onu hiçbir göz görmedi, hiçbir kulak işitmedi ve hiçbir beşer kalbine gelmedi.’”
texts.en: It is narrated from al-Mughīrah ibn Shuʿbah (RA) from the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) that he said: “Moses (PBUH) asked his Lord: ‘What is the lowest rank of the people of Paradise?’ He said: ‘It is a man who comes after the people of Paradise have been admitted to Paradise. It will be said to him: Enter Paradise. He will say: My Lord, how, when the people have settled in their places and taken their portions? It will be said to him: Would you be pleased to have the like of the kingdom of one of the kings of the world? He will say: I am pleased, my Lord. It will be said: That is for you, and the like of it, and the like of it, and the like of it, and the like of it. At the fifth he will say: I am pleased, my Lord. He will say: This is for you, and ten times its like; and you will have whatever your soul desires and whatever delights your eye. He will say: I am pleased, my Lord.’ He said: ‘My Lord, and the highest of them in rank?’ He said: ‘They are those whom I have willed. I planted their honor with My hand and sealed it; no eye has seen it, no ear has heard it, and it has not occurred to the heart of any human being.’”

texts.ar: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "إني لأعلم آخر النار خروجاً منها، وآخر أهل الجنة دخولاً الجنة، رجل يخرج من النار حبوا؛ فيقول الله عز وجل له: اذهب فادخل الجنة، فيأتيها، فيخيل إليه أنها ملأى، فيرجع فيقول: يا رب وجدتها ملأى، فيقول الله عز وجل له: اذهب فادخل الجنة، فيرجع ، فيقول: يا رب وجدتها ملأى، في سورة يقول الله عز وجل له : اذهب فادخل الجنة ، فيأتيها، فيخيل إليه أنها ملأى، فيرجع، فيقول: يا رب وجدتها ملأى! فيقول الله عز وجل له: اذهب فادخل الجنة، فإن لك مثل الدنيا وعشرة أمثالها أو إن لك مثل عشرة أمثال الدنيا، فيقول: أتسخر بي، أو تضحك بي وأنت الملك” قال: فلقد رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ضحك حتى بدت نواجذه فكان يقول: "ذلك أدنى أهل الجنة منزلة"
texts.tr: İbn Mes‘ûd (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurdu: “Ben cehennemden en son çıkacak ve cennete en son girecek kişiyi bilirim. O, cehennemden sürünerek çıkan bir adamdır. Allah azze ve celle ona: Git, cennete gir, buyurur. O cennete gelir; ona cennet doluymuş gibi gösterilir. Geri döner ve: Rabbim, onu dolu buldum, der. Allah azze ve celle ona: Git, cennete gir, buyurur. O geri döner ve: Rabbim, onu dolu buldum, der. Bir defasında Allah azze ve celle ona: Git, cennete gir, buyurur. O cennete gelir; ona yine doluymuş gibi gösterilir. Geri döner ve: Rabbim, onu dolu buldum, der. Bunun üzerine Allah azze ve celle ona: Git, cennete gir; çünkü sana dünya kadar ve onun on misli vardır —veya sana dünyanın on misli kadar vardır— buyurur. Adam: Sen hükümdar olduğun hâlde benimle alay mı ediyorsun, yoksa bana mı gülüyorsun? der.” Râvi dedi ki: Resûlullah (sav)’in azı dişleri görününceye kadar güldüğünü gördüm. O şöyle derdi: “İşte bu, cennet ehlinin makam bakımından en aşağısıdır.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Ibn Masʿūd (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “I know the last person to come out of the Fire and the last of the people of Paradise to enter Paradise. He is a man who comes out of the Fire crawling. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will say to him: Go and enter Paradise. He will come to it, and it will appear to him as though it is full. He will return and say: My Lord, I found it full. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will say to him: Go and enter Paradise. He will return and say: My Lord, I found it full. In one instance Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will say to him: Go and enter Paradise. He will come to it, and it will appear to him as though it is full. He will return and say: My Lord, I found it full. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will say to him: Go and enter Paradise, for you will have the like of the world and ten times its like—or you will have ten times the like of the world. He will say: Are You mocking me, or laughing at me, while You are the King?” He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) laugh until his molar teeth appeared. He used to say: “That is the lowest in rank among the people of Paradise.”

texts.ar: وعن أبي موسى رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إن للمؤمن في الجنة لخيمة من لؤلؤة واحدة مجوفة طولها في السماء ستون ميلاً، للمؤمن فيها أهلون، يطوف عليهم المؤمن فلا يرى بعضهم بعضاً، «الميل» : ستة آلاف ذراع
texts.tr: Ebû Mûsâ (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Peygamber (sav) şöyle buyurmuştur: “Mümin için cennette içi oyuk tek bir inciden bir çadır vardır; gökteki uzunluğu altmış mildir. Müminin orada aileleri vardır; mümin onların arasında dolaşır, fakat onların bir kısmı diğer kısmını görmez.” “Mil”, altı bin ziradır.
texts.en: It is narrated from Abū Mūsā (RA) that the Prophet (PBUH) said: “For the believer in Paradise there will be a tent made of a single hollow pearl, its height in the sky being sixty miles. The believer will have families therein; he will go around among them, yet some of them will not see others.” A “mile” is six thousand cubits.

Müminin orada aileleri vardır; mümin onların arasında dolaşır, fakat onların bir kısmı diğer kısmını görmez.” “Mil”, altı bin ziradır.

texts.ar: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إن في الجنة لشجرة يسير الراكب الجواد المضمر السريع مائة سنة ما يقطعها " وروياه في "الصحيحين" أيضاً من رواية أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: "يسير الراكب في سورة في ظلها سنة ما يقطعها".
texts.tr: Ebû Saîd el-Hudrî (ra)’tan, Peygamber (sav)’den rivayet edildiğine göre o şöyle buyurdu: “Cennette öyle bir ağaç vardır ki iyi yetiştirilmiş, hızlı giden bir atlı onun altında yüz yıl yol alsa onu kat edemez.” Buhârî ve Müslim bunu Ebû Hüreyre (ra) rivayetiyle de “Bir atlı onun gölgesinde yüz yıl yürür de onu kat edemez.” lafzıyla rivayet etmişlerdir.
texts.en: It is narrated from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī (RA) from the Prophet (PBUH) that he said: “In Paradise there is a tree under which a rider on a well-bred, swift horse would travel for one hundred years and not traverse it.” Al-Bukhārī and Muslim also narrated it in the Ṣaḥīḥayn from Abū Hurayrah, (RA): “A rider would travel in its shade for one hundred years and not traverse it.”

texts.ar: وعنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إن أهل الجنة ليتراءون أهل الغرف من فوقهم كما تراءون الكوكب الدري الغابر في الأفق من المشرق أو المغرب لتفاضل ملا بينهم" قالوا: يا رسول الله، تلك منازل الأنبياء لا يبلغها غيرهم؟ قال: “بلى والذي نفسي بيده رجال آمنوا بالله وصدقوا المرسلين"
texts.tr: Yine Ebû Saîd’den, Peygamber (sav)’den rivayet edildiğine göre o şöyle buyurdu: “Cennet ehli, üstlerindeki odaların ehlini, sizin doğuda veya batıda ufukta kaybolan parlak yıldızı gördüğünüz gibi görürler; aralarındaki üstünlük farkından dolayı.” Sahâbîler: “Ey Allah’ın Resûlü! Bunlar peygamberlerin makamlarıdır; onlara başkaları ulaşamaz, değil mi?” dediler. O şöyle buyurdu: “Hayır; nefsim elinde olana yemin ederim ki onlar Allah’a iman eden ve gönderilenleri tasdik eden kimselerdir.”
texts.en: It is narrated from him, from the Prophet (PBUH) that he said: “The people of Paradise will see the people of the chambers above them as you see the brilliant star disappearing on the horizon in the east or the west, because of the difference in rank between them.” They said: “O Messenger of Allah, are those the stations of the prophets, which no one else can attain?” He said: “Rather, by the One in Whose hand is my soul, they are men who believed in Allah and affirmed the messengers.”

texts.ar: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "لقاب قوس في الجنة خير مما تطلع عليه الشمس أو تغرب"
texts.tr: Ebû Hüreyre (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurdu: “Cennette bir yay kadar yer, güneşin üzerine doğduğu veya battığı her şeyden daha hayırlıdır.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Abū Hurayrah (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “The space of a bow in Paradise is better than all upon which the sun rises or sets.”

texts.ar: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إن في الجنة سوقاً يأتونها كل جمعة. فتهب ريح الشمال، فتحثوا في وجوههم وثيابهم، فيزدادون حسناً وجمالاً فيرجعون إلى أهليهم، وقد ازدادوا حسناً وجمالاً، فيقول لهم أهلوهم: والله لقد ازددتم حسناً وجمالاً! فيقولون: وأنتم والله لقد ازددتم بعدنا حسناً وجمالاً!"
texts.tr: Enes (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurdu: “Cennette bir pazar vardır; onlar her cuma oraya gelirler. Kuzey rüzgârı eser, yüzlerine ve elbiselerine koku saçar; böylece güzellikleri ve cemalleri artar. Ailelerinin yanına, güzellikleri ve cemalleri artmış olarak dönerler. Aileleri onlara: ‘Vallahi sizden sonra güzellik ve cemal bakımından artmışsınız!’ derler. Onlar da: ‘Siz de vallahi bizden sonra güzellik ve cemal bakımından artmışsınız!’ derler.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Anas (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “In Paradise there is a marketplace to which they will come every Friday. The north wind will blow and scatter fragrance upon their faces and garments, so they will increase in beauty and loveliness. They will return to their families having increased in beauty and loveliness, and their families will say to them: ‘By Allah, you have increased in beauty and loveliness after us!’ They will say: ‘And you, by Allah, have increased in beauty and loveliness after us!’”

texts.ar: وعن سهل بن سعد رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إن أهل الجنة ليتراءون الغرف في الجنة كما تتراءون الكوكب في السماء"
texts.tr: Sehl b. Sa‘d (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurmuştur: “Cennet ehli cennetteki odaları, sizin gökteki yıldızı gördüğünüz gibi görürler.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Sahl ibn Saʿd (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “The people of Paradise will see the chambers in Paradise as you see the star in the sky.”

texts.ar: وعنه رضي الله عنه قال: شهدت من النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مجلساً وصف فيه الجنة حتى انتهى، ثم قال في آخر حديثه: "فيها مالا عين رأت، ولا أذن سمعت، ولا خطر على قلب بشر" ثم قرأ {تتجافى جنوبهم عن المضاجع} إلى قوله تعالى: {فلا تعلم نفس ما أخفي لهم من قرة أعين}.
texts.tr: Yine Sehl b. Sa‘d (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre o şöyle demiştir: Peygamber (sav)’in cenneti anlattığı bir meclisinde bulundum; sözünü tamamlayınca hadisinin sonunda şöyle buyurdu: “Orada hiçbir gözün görmediği, hiçbir kulağın işitmediği ve hiçbir beşer kalbine gelmeyen şeyler vardır.” Sonra “Yanları yataklardan uzaklaşır...” ayetinden “onlar için göz aydınlığı olarak nelerin gizlendiğini hiçbir nefis bilmez” buyruğuna kadar okudu.
texts.en: It is narrated from him (RA) that he said: I attended a gathering of the Prophet (PBUH) in which he described Paradise until he finished. At the end of his speech he said: “In it is what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and what has not occurred to the heart of any human being.” Then he recited: “Their sides forsake their beds...” up to His saying: “No soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes.”
texts.tr_cpt_original: Yine Sehl b. Sa‘d radıyallahu anh’tan rivayet edildiğine göre o şöyle demiştir: Peygamber sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in cenneti anlattığı bir meclisinde bulundum; sözünü tamamlayınca hadisinin sonunda şöyle buyurdu: “Orada hiçbir gözün görmediği, hiçbir kulağın işitmediği ve hiçbir beşer kalbine gelmeyen şeyler vardır.” Sonra “Yanları yataklardan uzaklaşır...” ayetinden “onlar için göz aydınlığı olarak nelerin gizlendiğini hiçbir nefis bilmez” buyruğuna kadar okudu.

texts.ar: وعن أبي سعيد وأبي هريرة رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: “إذا دخل أهل الجنة - الجنة- ينادي مناد: إن لكم أن تحيوا، فلا تموتوا أبداً، وإن لكم أن تصحوا، فلا تسقموا أبداً، وإن لكم أن تشبوا فلا تهرموا أبداً، وإن لكم أن تنعموا، فلا تبأسوا أبداً"
texts.tr: Ebû Saîd ve Ebû Hüreyre (ra)’dan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurdu: “Cennet ehli cennete girdiğinde bir münadi şöyle seslenir: Sizin için yaşamak vardır; artık asla ölmeyeceksiniz. Sizin için sağlıklı olmak vardır; artık asla hastalanmayacaksınız. Sizin için genç kalmak vardır; artık asla yaşlanmayacaksınız. Sizin için nimet içinde olmak vardır; artık asla sıkıntıya düşmeyeceksiniz.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Abū Saʿīd and Abū Hurayrah (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “When the people of Paradise enter Paradise, a caller will call out: You shall live and never die; you shall be healthy and never become ill; you shall remain young and never grow old; and you shall enjoy bliss and never suffer misery.”
texts.tr_cpt_original: Ebû Saîd ve Ebû Hüreyre radıyallahu anhümâ’dan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Cennet ehli cennete girdiğinde bir münadi şöyle seslenir: Sizin için yaşamak vardır; artık asla ölmeyeceksiniz. Sizin için sağlıklı olmak vardır; artık asla hastalanmayacaksınız. Sizin için genç kalmak vardır; artık asla yaşlanmayacaksınız. Sizin için nimet içinde olmak vardır; artık asla sıkıntıya düşmeyeceksiniz.”
texts.en_cpt_translation: It is narrated from Abū Saʿīd and Abū Hurayrah, may Allah be pleased with them both, that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “When the people of Paradise enter Paradise, a caller will call out: You shall live and never die; you shall be healthy and never become ill; you shall remain young and never grow old; and you shall enjoy bliss and never suffer misery.”

texts.ar: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إن أدنى مقعد أحدكم من الجنة أن يقول له: تمن فيتمنى ويتمنى، فيقول له: هل تمنيت؟ فيقول: نعم، فيقول له: فإن لك ما تمنيت ومثله معه"
texts.tr: Ebû Hüreyre (ra)’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurdu: “Sizden birinizin cennetteki en aşağı oturma yeri şudur: Ona, ‘Dile!’ denilir. O da diler ve diler. Ona, ‘Diledin mi?’ denilir. ‘Evet.’ der. Bunun üzerine ona: ‘Dilediğin şey ve onun bir misli daha senindir.’ denilir.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Abū Hurayrah (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “The lowest seat of one of you in Paradise is that it will be said to him: Wish. So he will wish and wish. It will be said to him: Have you wished? He will say: Yes. Then it will be said to him: You shall have what you wished for, and the like of it along with it.”

texts.ar: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إن الله عز وجل يقول لأهل الجنة: يا أهل الجنة، فيقولون : لبيك ربنا وسعديك، والخير في يديك فيقول: هل رضيتم؟ فيقولون: وما لنا لا نرضى يا ربنا وقد أعطيتنا مالم تعط أحداً من خلقك! فيقول: ألا أعطيكم أفضل من ذلك فيقولون: وأي شيء أفضل من ذلك؟ فيقول: أحل عليكم رضواني، فلا أسخط عليكم بعده أبداً"
texts.tr: Ebû Saîd el-Hudrî (ra)’dan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurdu: “Şüphesiz Allah azze ve celle cennet ehline şöyle der: ‘Ey cennet ehli!’ Onlar da: ‘Buyur Rabbimiz, emrine amadeyiz; hayır Senin elindedir’ derler. Allah: ‘Razı oldunuz mu?’ buyurur. Onlar: ‘Ey Rabbimiz! Bize yaratıklarından hiç kimseye vermediğin şeyleri vermişken biz nasıl razı olmayalım?’ derler. Allah: ‘Size bundan daha üstününü vereyim mi?’ buyurur. Onlar: ‘Bundan daha üstün ne olabilir?’ derler. Allah: ‘Size rızâmı helâl kıldım; bundan sonra size asla gazap etmeyeceğim’ buyurur.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Abu Sa‘id al-Khudri (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “Indeed Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will say to the people of Paradise: ‘O people of Paradise!’ They will say: ‘Here we are, our Lord, at Your service; all good is in Your hands.’ He will say: ‘Are you pleased?’ They will say: ‘Why should we not be pleased, our Lord, when You have given us what You have not given to anyone among Your creation?’ He will say: ‘Shall I not give you something better than that?’ They will say: ‘What could be better than that?’ He will say: ‘I bestow My pleasure upon you, and I shall never be angry with you after this.’”

texts.ar: وعن جرير بن عبد الله رضي الله عنه قال: كنا عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فنظر إلى القمر ليلة البدر، وقال: "إنكم سترون ربكم عياناً كما ترون هذا القمر، لا تضامون في رؤيته" .
texts.tr: Cerîr b. Abdullah (ra) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (sav)’in yanında bulunuyorduk. Dolunay gecesinde aya baktı ve şöyle buyurdu: “Şüphesiz siz Rabbinizi apaçık göreceksiniz; şu ayı gördüğünüz gibi. O’nu görmede birbirinize sıkıntı vermeyecek, izdihama düşmeyeceksiniz.”
texts.en: Jarir ibn ‘Abdullah (RA) said: We were with the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) and he looked at the moon on the night of the full moon and said: “Indeed, you will see your Lord plainly, just as you see this moon; you will not be harmed or crowded in seeing Him.”

Dolunay gecesinde aya baktı ve şöyle buyurdu: “Şüphesiz siz Rabbinizi apaçık göreceksiniz; şu ayı gördüğünüz gibi. O’nu görmede birbirinize sıkıntı vermeyecek, izdihama düşmeyeceksiniz.”
texts.en_cpt_translation: Jarir ibn ‘Abdullah, may Allah be pleased with him, said: We were with the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, and he looked at the moon on the night of the full moon and said: “Indeed, you will see your Lord plainly, just as you see this moon; you will not be harmed or crowded in seeing Him.”

texts.ar: وعن صهيب رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إذا دخل أهل الجنة -الجنة- يقول الله تبارك وتعالى: تريدون شيئاً أزيدكم؟ فيقولون: ألم تبيض وجوهنا؟ ألم تدخلنا الجنة وتنجنا من النار؟ فيكشف الحجاب، فما أعطو شيئاً أحب إليهم من النظر إلى ربهم" قال الله تعالى: {إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات يهديهم ربهم بإيمانهم تجري من تحتهم الأنهار في جنات النعيم* دعواهم فيها سبحانك اللهم وتحيتهم فيها سلام وآخر دعواهم أن الحمد لله رب العالمين} ((يونس:9،10)). الحمد لله الذي هدانا لهذا وما كنا لنهتدى لولا أن هدانا الله. اللهم صل على محمد وعلى آل محمد، كما صليت على إبراهيم وعلى آل إبراهيم ، وبارك على محمد، وعلى آل محمد، كما باركت على إبراهيم وعلى آل إبراهيم ، إنك حميد مجيد. قال مؤلفه رضي الله عنه : " فرغت منه يوم الاثنين رابع شهر رمضان سنة سبعين وستمائة".
texts.tr: Suheyb (ra)’dan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (sav) şöyle buyurdu: “Cennet ehli cennete girdiğinde Allah Tebâreke ve Teâlâ şöyle buyurur: ‘Size daha da artırmamı istediğiniz bir şey var mı?’ Onlar: ‘Yüzlerimizi ak etmedin mi? Bizi cennete koyup ateşten kurtarmadın mı?’ derler. Bunun üzerine perde kaldırılır. Onlara Rablerine bakmaktan daha sevimli hiçbir şey verilmemiştir.” Allah Teâlâ şöyle buyurmuştur: “İman edip salih ameller işleyenlere gelince, Rableri imanları sebebiyle onları doğru yola iletir; nimet cennetlerinde altlarından ırmaklar akar. Oradaki duaları: ‘Allah’ım, Seni tesbih ederiz’ sözüdür; oradaki selamlaşmaları ‘selâm’dır; dualarının sonu ise: ‘Hamd, âlemlerin Rabbi Allah’a mahsustur’ sözüdür.” (Yûnus: 9, 10). Bizi buna hidayet eden Allah’a hamdolsun; Allah bizi hidayet etmeseydi biz doğru yolu bulamazdık. Allah’ım, İbrâhim’e ve İbrâhim’in ailesine salât ettiğin gibi Muhammed’e ve Muhammed’in ailesine salât et; İbrâhim’e ve İbrâhim’in ailesine bereket verdiğin gibi Muhammed’e ve Muhammed’in ailesine bereket ver. Şüphesiz Sen hamde lâyık ve yücesin. Müellifi (ra) şöyle dedi: “Bu eseri hicrî 670 yılı Ramazan ayının dördüncü günü olan pazartesi günü tamamladım.”
texts.en: It is narrated from Suhayb (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “When the people of Paradise enter Paradise, Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, will say: ‘Do you want anything more that I may give you?’ They will say: ‘Have You not brightened our faces? Have You not admitted us into Paradise and saved us from the Fire?’ Then the veil will be lifted, and they will not have been given anything more beloved to them than looking at their Lord.” Allah, Exalted is He, said: “Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds—their Lord will guide them by their faith; rivers will flow beneath them in the Gardens of Bliss. Their supplication therein will be, ‘Glory be to You, O Allah,’ and their greeting therein will be, ‘Peace,’ and the last of their supplication will be, ‘Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.’” (Yunus: 9, 10). Praise be to Allah who guided us to this; we would not have been guided had Allah not guided us. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; and bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. Its author (RA) said: “I completed it on Monday, the fourth day of the month of Ramadan, in the year six hundred and seventy.”
